en_title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Producer Explains Roman’s Backstory
cn_title: 制作人：Roman身世将永远保密
subtitle: 留住夜之城的一抹纯真
opus_summary: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》制作人表示，团队删减了Roman与父亲的对话，以免透露太多身世。他承诺系列永不揭晓其过往，希望保留角色的纯真感，让观众自行想象。

paragraphs.en: I got the chance to ask Bartosz Sztybor, the showrunner, writer, and producer for Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2, all of my burning questions about the anime's latest season — particularly about one central character’s backstory (or lack thereof).
paragraphs.cn: 我有机会采访了《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的剧集统筹、编剧兼制片人Bartosz Sztybor，把有关这部动画最新一季、我一直迫切想知道的问题都问了个遍，尤其是某位核心角色的背景故事——或者说，他为何没有背景故事。

paragraphs.en: Warning: Major spoilers for Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 below!
paragraphs.cn: 警告：下文涉及《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》重大剧透！

paragraphs.en: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 follows a totally different cast of characters from the show’s first season. One of these characters is named Roman, a young boy who loves all things retro and has a special affinity for old-school cinema. In fact, he loves traditional films so much that he carries around an old-school camcorder, which he uses to record the events around him in favor of the straight-to-your-cranium braindances (BDs).
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的角色阵容与第一季完全不同。其中有个名叫Roman的小男孩，他喜欢一切复古事物，尤其钟爱老电影。他对传统电影的喜爱之深，甚至让他随身带着一台老式摄像机，用它来记录身边发生的事，而不是选择直接将体验传入大脑的超梦（BD）。

paragraphs.en: Although we get a good glimpse at the tragedies that made our other main characters the way they are (Weak Kingsley, D, Talia Yang), Roman’s backstory is notably absent from the mix. And while he’s so young that it could be argued the events of this season basically serve as his backstory, there’s something that nagged at me the entire time I was watching: Why was his dad so permissive?
paragraphs.cn: 我们得以一窥其他几位主角（Weak Kingsley、D、Talia Yang）经历的悲剧，了解他们为何成了如今的模样，唯独Roman的背景故事明显缺席了。他年纪这么小，固然可以说这一季发生的事基本上就是他的背景故事，但我在观看时始终有个疑问挥之不去：他爸爸为什么这么放任他？

paragraphs.en: Maybe it’s my strict upbringing talking, but I was surprised to see how freely Roman’s father let him roam around Night City (even letting him bring D to his house on a few occasions). When asked about this, Sztybor revealed that, surprisingly, this wasn’t always the plan for Roman and his dad.
paragraphs.cn: 也许是因为我从小家教严格，但看到Roman的父亲任由他在夜之城四处乱跑，甚至有几次还让他把D带回家，我还是很惊讶。被问及此事时，Sztybor透露了一个出人意料的情况：团队对Roman父子的安排，并非从一开始就是这样。

paragraphs.en: “He has things to do! He’s a barber and he trusts his boy,” he said of Roman’s father. “That was an artistic choice, not to explain too much. Roman is this glimpse of innocence in this weird, violent city, and walking happiness and trust and all that. I think that if you were to show his background… In our first draft of scripts, his dad had more dialogue with Roman, but we saw that it gave too much backstory to him. Then you start interpreting things, ‘Why is he this way?’
paragraphs.cn: 谈到Roman的父亲时，他说：「他还有事情要忙呢！他是个理发师，而且他信任自己的孩子。」「不作过多解释，是艺术上的取舍。在这座怪异而暴力的城市里，Roman让人瞥见了一丝纯真，他身上体现着快乐、信任等等。我觉得，如果展现他的背景……在我们的剧本初稿里，他爸爸和Roman的对话更多，但我们发现，这交代了太多他的背景故事。这样一来，你就会开始解读，琢磨他为什么会是这个样子。」

paragraphs.en: “I think it should be something for the audience that they just feel, ‘Okay, he’s that guy.’ You can, of course, start thinking and start creating his story and background, which is fine. I would say that telling too much about himself, his past, his family would destroy the feelings of who he is. This is the promise that I’m making, never in the Cyberpunk franchise will we show his backstory. It will be kept secret.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我觉得应该让观众只是感觉：好吧，他就是这样一个人。当然，你可以开始琢磨，自己构想他的故事和背景，这没什么问题。但我认为，如果过多讲述他自己、他的过去和他的家庭，就会破坏他带给人的感觉。我在这里作出承诺：《赛博朋克》系列永远不会揭示他的背景故事。这会一直是个秘密。」

paragraphs.en: I brought up my feeling that Roman was the lens through which we, the audience, watch the events of Edgerunners 2 unfold — and Sztybor acknowledged this take, while also revealing how he came to the conclusion of having a cinephile-type character being the central connecting thread to all of the other players in the story.
paragraphs.cn: 我提到，在我看来，我们这些观众是透过Roman的视角，看着《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的故事展开的。Sztybor认可了这一解读，也透露了他是如何决定让一个影迷型角色成为串联故事中其他所有人物的核心线索。

paragraphs.en: “The first pitch for Studio Trigger was, ‘I want to do an homage to the pop culture of the 90s. I want a pulp fiction kind of story with several characters that, at one point, connect.’ Working with Kai Igarashi, we discovered we are both cinephiles and we love cinema. We needed something, someone that connected all the characters, and if we were already doing an homage to pop culture of the 80s and the 90s — not just at the story level, but the visual level — then a cinephile kid would be a perfect choice. We thought this one innocent guy who loves retro, who is this glimpse of hope, and suddenly he’s the connection between all those flawed characters, would be an amazing choice.”
paragraphs.cn: 「最初向Trigger工作室提案时，我说想向90年代的流行文化致敬，想讲一个低俗小说式的故事，让几个人物在某个时刻产生交集。在与五十岚海合作的过程中，我们发现彼此都是影迷，都热爱电影。我们需要某种东西，或者某个人，把所有角色联系起来。既然我们已经在向80年代和90年代的流行文化致敬，而且不只是在故事层面，也包括视觉层面，那么一个影迷少年就是完美的选择。我们觉得，让这样一个天真、喜爱复古事物、代表着一线希望的男孩，突然成为所有这些有缺陷的角色之间的纽带，会是个很棒的选择。」

paragraphs.en: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 is out now exclusively on Netflix. You can read our review here , where we scored it a 9 out of 10, saying it “delivers the gory, action-packed goods, even if it doesn’t quite hit the highs of its predecessor.”
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》现已在Netflix独家上线。你可以在这里阅读我们的评测，我们给出了9分的评价，称其「带来了血腥、动作场面十足的精彩内容，尽管未能完全达到前作的高度」。

paragraphs.en: Returning to Cyberpunk 2077 or playing it for the first time? We’ve got a new and improved Cyberpunk interactive map to help you find every mission, Iconic item, and collectible in the game. Plus, we’ve also got a full walkthrough for the base game, a Phantom Liberty walkthrough , and an overview of all the Cyberpunk 2077 endings so you don’t make a choice you regret. And we can’t ignore the various romance options you can smooch, which also impact how V’s story concludes.
paragraphs.cn: 你是准备重返《赛博朋克2077》，还是第一次游玩？我们全新改进的《赛博朋克》互动地图可以帮你找到游戏中的每个任务、每件不朽物品和每个收集品。此外，我们还准备了本体完整流程攻略、《往日之影》流程攻略，以及《赛博朋克2077》全部结局的概览，帮你避免作出让自己后悔的选择。当然，也不能忘了那些可以与你亲吻的恋爱对象，他们同样会影响V的故事如何收尾。
